visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a light blue t-shirt with a Stitch graphic and a younger girl in a blue and white floral patterned shirt stand side-by-side in a well-lit indoor room. They are looking towards the camera with expectant, joyful expressions. (2) A person wearing a tie-dye shirt and glasses reaches for a dark handle on a light-colored wooden door with an arched top. They turn the knob and pull the door open toward the camera. (3) As the door opens, the boy and girl hold hands and step across the threshold from a hallway into the main room. A man in a blue t-shirt stands in the background doorway, watching them. (4) In a series of jump cuts, the children repeat their entrance. The boy waves enthusiastically, and the girl jumps and raises her arms in excitement. The man in the background is seen holding a smartphone to record the scene. (5) The young girl walks into the room alone, smiling broadly and looking towards the person filming. A framed photo collage is visible on the wall behind her. The lighting is warm and bright, highlighting the wooden floor and neutral-toned walls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, major-key electronic pop music begins with a steady drum machine beat and bright synthesizer pads. A high-arousal female voice cheers enthusiastically with non-lexical exclamations. (2) A clear mechanical click of a door handle occurs. The female voice shouts "Yay!" followed by high-pitched, joyful vocalizations from two children. (3) The rhythmic music continues at approximately 128 BPM. Short, frequent bursts of laughter and excited shouting from the children overlap with the consistent cheering of the adult female. (4) Another mechanical latch sound is heard as the audio track seems to jump. The vocal energy remains consistently high with rising intonations, signaling extreme excitement and celebration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Rehearsal Stages -> Repeated Action -> Successful Performance
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a lighthearted and joyful family moment where two young children are practicing their roles as flower girl and page boy for their parents' upcoming wedding. It aims to document and share the cute, energetic rehearsal process with a warm, celebratory tone.
